rows.63:0dac:
Yes, a sweet smile, just like that...
...Thank you.
I must have startled you, saying something so strange out of nowhere.
I'm sorry.
It's just that something caught my interest...{p}
rows.63:1704:
Don't you remember...?
Three years ago, on the road to the airport, there was that massive chain-reaction pileup that left so many dead and injured, wasn't there?
The car he was in got caught up in that crash.
It was a truly horrific accident.
More than thirty people were killed...
And Yuya's name was among them.
rows.63:1c5c:
I lay dozing on my bed, wrapped in that dusky gloom.
Before me was the familiar door.
...Yes, it was my own room, after all.
Of course it was familiar...
On the other side of that door, I could sense someone.
...Someone was there!
And that someone... could only be him!
Strange, isn't it?
I felt an odd certainty.
...He had come back.
Back to me, just as he promised...
That's what I believed, without the slightest doubt or fear.
<Yuya...?>
I sat up and called out softly.
And then...
<Akemi...
It's me. I've come back.
Won't you open the door?>
The answer from the other side of the door was Yuya's voice, without a doubt.
I could never mistake the voice of the one I love, could I?
...The voice went on.
<That's right.
Akemi... I promised you, didn't I?
That I'd be sure to come back to you...
Hurry, open the door.>
Of course, I opened it.
I wanted to see Yuya's face as soon as I could.
On unsteady legs I rose and flung the door wide open.{p}
rows.63:22f4:
Spirits hate having their existence denied, you know.
More than anyone, they want people to notice that they exist.
Yuya is the same.
Normally he wouldn't do anything to harm people, but...
If you deny his existence in a single word, calling him a 'dream' or an 'illusion,' he gets terribly angry.{p}
rows.63:2478:
"You only saw an illusion like that because you think of nothing but Yuya, don't you?"
My mother, who said that and didn't believe in him one bit, vanished from my life one day.
She divorced my father.
...And they had been such a loving couple, too.
A classmate who asked me out on a date, never noticing him, suddenly died.
On the railroad tracks, in the dead of night...
...They say it was suicide, but I have my doubts.
There are plenty of others, too.
The classmate who was cruel to me went missing...
Oh, yes...
Just recently, there was a boy who asked me to go out with him.
He was, if I remember right, a second-year...{p}
rows.63:2cc8:
"Now, where was I...?"
Iwashita murmured, then giggled softly as if remembering something.{p}
rows.63:2d94:
Heh heh heh heh...
Even though Yuya is my sweetheart.
Of course, I turned him down.
I told him I already have a sweetheart...{p}
rows.63:2e1c:
But Yoshino just wouldn't give up.
"You're lying!
There's no way you have a sweetheart☆"
...he said, and he kept pestering me.
Just then...
I felt something sway softly behind me.
Ah, Yuya is angry...
That's what I thought.
So I just let Yoshino be.
Because I knew that before long, Yuya's wrath would destroy him...
And I was right.
Yoshino jumped from the roof of the school building.
He left no note, nothing at all.
Well, if I had to give a reason, I suppose it would be the shock of a broken heart?
That was just three days ago...{p}
rows.63:7ae8:
...The one lying down there was Yoshino, without a doubt.
He once gave me a love letter.
Yes, of course I turned him down.
'I already have a sweetheart'... I told him.
That was during lunch break today.
But Yoshino just wouldn't give up.
"You're lying!
There's no way you have a sweetheart☆"
...he insisted...
And then...
I felt as though something swayed behind me.
Ah, Yuya is angry...
That's what I thought.
So I pushed Yoshino away, coldly.
"I hate your guts!"
...like that.
I thought that way I could keep him from coming to harm.
After all, everyone who gets close to me, everyone who does me harm, meets with some ill-omened accident.
I thought that if I treated him coldly, Yuya's anger would subside.
...But it seems I was naive.
Yoshino is dead.
Was it because of Yuya's anger...?
Or was it suicide, from the shock of being rejected...?
So now there's one more unfortunate person around me.{p}
rows.63:315c:
...Tell me, {a}.
A man like Yuya is the finest sweetheart there is.
True love is the kind of love that exists between us.{p}Isn't it wonderful?
rows.63:8018:
Heh heh heh...
...Thank you.
You should have a love like this too, {a}.
He keeps me bound to him because he loves me that much...{p}
rows.63:3618:
Heh heh heh...
The truth is, quite a few boys are fond of you.
Those boys tell me,
"{b} {a} in Class 1-E has the best smile!"
...I hear it all the time, you see...
To tell the truth, I was looking forward to meeting you today.
...Well?{p}Will you smile for me?
rows.63:3b80:
Oh my, you sound rather unsure.
It must be because the two of you don't truly love each other with all your hearts.
Perhaps you haven't met your real destined partner yet...
...Don't be disappointed.
The chance of two people meeting is one in hundreds of millions, after all.
Heh, it's all right.
I'm sure you'll meet someone wonderful.
Someone who will love you more than anyone else in this world...{p}
rows.63:3ee8:
...Oh, you don't care for sportsmen either?
I understand.
You'd prefer a grown man, much, much older than you.
...In that case, it'll have to be a teacher, of course.{p}
rows.63:59a4: The last thing I heard was the strained, twitching laughter of a man whose voice I didn't recognize...........{p}
rows.63:5d88:
Heh heh, I see.
So right now your love is one-sided.
Tell me, {a}...
The person you like must be someone wonderful.{p}If you don't mind... won't you tell me that person's name?
rows.63:64a4:
Iwashita sat perfectly still, barely breathing.
...Is she angry?
I did say something weird...
I like Iwashita, but that feeling is completely different from romantic love.
"I see..."
Iwashita murmured briefly, then let out a sigh.
And then...{p}
rows.63:6a00:
A boy who bumped into me in the hallway was sent flying five meters and slammed into the wall.
And our shoulders had barely even brushed.
The art club member who painted my portrait broke an arm...
The boy who lent me a book fell down the stairs and broke a bone.
One eerie accident after another kept happening around me.
Before long, nobody would come near me.
I was worn out, too, somehow...
Little by little, I came to live in fear of the visions and voices I saw and heard.
I'd grown terribly afraid of meeting people...{p}
rows.63:6e50:
I mean, think about it.
There's no way he would die and leave me behind, when he loved me more than anyone.
He died because of me.
Yuya kept his promise and came back even after death, but I had a change of heart, so Yuya got angry.
The accidents that had kept happening until then were all Yuya's doing, too.{p}
